entries.original: Full Access skips Guardian reviews for confirmation-only actions. ([#42147](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42147), [#42256](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42256))

entries.original: Guardian review history survives compaction, restarts, and user-created forks while respecting rollback boundaries and isolating subagent history. ([#41879](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41879), [#42065](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42065))
